about: Overrides applied by scripts/scene-import.ts (see src/modules/scene/scene-overrides.ts): "buildings" = roof elevation of one building, "hidden" = a GeoPackage building that is not drawn, "parts" = one footprint drawn as several flat-roofed blocks, "added" = a building that is not in the GeoPackage or the campus map (scene only). Remove an entry, or import with --no-overrides, to get the GeoPackage model back. S-MAP is not an independent survey: values here agree with S-MAP, not with a field measurement.
